name: LLM_benchmark_data
description:
Welcome to BenCzechMark. This repository contains automatically uploaded  published submissions from BenCzechMark. These are located in LLM_benchmark_data/tree/main/data
More information can be found at the BenCzechMark leaderboard.
evaluation_method: mixed (varies by task; e.g., accuracy, exact_match, BLEU, pass@k, human_eval)
reputation: Community-contributed collection of LLM benchmark submissions with limited, niche adoption outside BenCzechMark contributors.
